WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name AS cust_first_name, c.last_name AS cust_last_name, c.support_rep_id, SUM(i.total) AS total_spend FROM customer AS c JOIN invoice AS i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.support_rep_id), max_spend AS (SELECT support_rep_id, MAX(total_spend) AS max_spend FROM customer_spend GROUP BY support_rep_id) SELECT e.first_name AS rep_first_name, e.last_name AS rep_last_name, cs.cust_first_name, cs.cust_last_name, cs.total_spend AS spend FROM customer_spend AS cs JOIN max_spend AS ms ON cs.support_rep_id = ms.support_rep_id AND cs.total_spend = ms.max_spend JOIN employee AS e ON cs.support_rep_id = e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id, cs.customer_id LIMIT 1000
